title: Affine etale evaluations jointly detect sheaf colimits
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and S a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let J be any small category, K:J→Sh(S_et,Λ) a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and B a cocone on K. Assume evaluation of B on every affine object V of S_et is a colimit cocone of Λ-modules. Then B is a colimit cocone of sheaves. No filteredness is required.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, affine-basis sheafification step; comparison lemma for dense subsites (03A0), Mathlib AffineEtale and FunctorCategory.Basic

proof.text: Restrict B to Mathlib Scheme.AffineEtale using its Spec functor. This is a dense subsite of S_et; restriction is an equivalence for complete module coefficients. Use the u-sized hypercover density and u-sized module limits, both available in Mathlib. Every image object has affine domain, so its evaluation cocone is colimiting by the hypothesis.

Apply Mathlib evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits to get a colimit of the restricted presheaf cocone. Reflect through the fully faithful sheaf-to-presheaf functor and then through the affine-site restriction equivalence, using isColimitOfReflects twice. These operations construct IsColimit B; they do not require any preservation assumption for evaluation or any filteredness.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_isColimit_of_affine_etale (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (S : Scheme.{u}) {J : Type u} [Category.{u} J] (K : J ⥤ Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (B : Cocone K) (h : ∀ (V : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left], Nonempty (IsColimit ((sheafToPresheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ⋙ (evaluation S.Etaleᵒᵖ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (op V)).mapCocone B))) : Nonempty (IsColimit B)
